title: Resolve and implement V18 login semantics
mission: Ground the visible generic V18 login control in an explicit durable auth contract before implementation. Replace the stub only when scope/provider/authority are established; otherwise make the control capability-honest. Never publish credentials or private content.
definition_of_done: Exact auth scope/provider is grounded by durable evidence before implementation.
The generic login stub is not silently aliased to Blackboard needs_login without an explicit contract.
If authority is sufficient, the control is implemented and regression-covered; otherwise UI clearly reflects the real capability boundary.
No credentials, tokens or private content are committed or published.
Version anterior remains accessible where needed and no promotion authority is implied.
